card.name: Linking words before sleepwalking examples
card.fires_on: Linking words or commas such as "including", "such as" or "," right before a list of sleep behaviors like sleep-walking and sleep-driving, mostly in complex sleep behavior warnings.

modes.label: Lead-in to sleep behaviors
modes.description: "including", "such as" or a comma that introduces sleepwalking and sleep-driving after the phrase complex sleep behaviors.

modes.description: A comma inside a list of paradoxical reactions, such as excitement and agitation.
